entries.name: On Attack / On Crit (+ Wielding: Blade)
On Attack / On Crit (+ Wielding: Polearm)
On Attack / On Crit (+ Wielding: Heavy)

system.description:
Grant protection to an adjacent friendly unit. You move into that unit's square. The protected unit must be your size or smaller. While on top of that protected unit, it cannot be targeted by any hostile actions, including Area wide effects. 

This effect breaks when either you or the protected unit exit the same square.

As a Bonus Action, relocate an adjacent unit, pulling them backwards. You also move backwards in the same direction. If the target unit is hostile to you, you must first pass an Athletics check (DC 3 + target's Bld).

The target must be the same size as the user. If the target is airborne, the user must be able to reach it in melee.
Once per map, as a Bonus Action, you may heal 2d6 + Mgt HP and restore 1d4 Stn. At 10th level, gain another 1d6 healing on your HP roll. At 20th level, gain another 1d4 on your Stn recovery roll.
A technique intended to dismount a rider from their horse. Your attack gains +2 Acc and becomes Effective against Cavalry units.
You specialize in fighting with a shield, granting yourself greater defensibility and offense. While you have a shield equipped, gain +1 Atk and +1 Eva.
While equipped with a heavy shield, friendly units adjacent to you gain +3 Def and Res.
Gain +6 Def when initiating a melee attack against a foe.
A shield forged in special metals that provide defensive bonuses against magic.
A full set of armor suitable for a well-trained knight. Boasts incredible protection at the cost of its weight.
